APPENDIX 27  Exchange Lists for Meal Planning
1020
MILK
Different types of milk and milk products are on this list. 
However, 2 types of milk products are found in other lists:
•	 Cheeses are on the Meat and Meat Substitutes list 
(because they are rich in protein).
•	 Cream and other dairy fats are on the Fats list.
Milks and yogurts are grouped in 3 categories (fat-free/low-fat, 
reduced-fat, or whole) based on the amount of fat they have.
